As a Senior Director, Full-stack Engineer at Capital One, you will lead high-performing engineering teams working to define the future of banking in the cloud. You will partner closely with product managers, designers, architects and executive leaders to deliver scalable, customer-centric solutions. Our Senior Directors are technical people leaders who drive engineering strategy, guide complex architectural decisions, and translate business goals into impactful technology platforms.

At Capital One, we believe diversity of thought strengthens our ability to influence, collaborate and provide the most innovative solutions across organizational boundaries. You will foster a culture of engineering excellence and inclusivity, balancing technical depth with empowered team leadership. You will lead the way in building next-generation talent for Capital One Tech—mentoring managers and engineers, driving workforce strategy and actively recruiting top-tier talent.

Architected and scaled Capital One’s frontline agentic banking ecosystem, driving technical transformation across customer service, remote support, and physical branch/Café environments outside the credit card domain. Spearheaded the development of distributed multi-agent systems that unify customer context across self-service tools, call center agents, and in-person Café Ambassadors. Senior Directors are expected to lead through technical vision, operational rigor and strategic alignment. jobs.job_title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Content Intelligence
jobs.job_description:
Job Description

Arc XP is the AI-powered content platform for media companies. Purpose-built for publishers and broadcasters, it is the CMS and content platform that ambitious media organizations across digital media, news publishing, broadcast, and B2B publishing use to create and distribute content, grow and engage their audiences, and monetize through subscriptions and advertising. Fully leveraging AWS, the platform is built on a microservices architecture, and our teams deploy new features and products daily. Arc XP currently powers more than 1,500 sites in 25 countries that reach more than 1.5 billion unique visitors monthly.

This position sits on the Content Intelligence team, which builds and operates the AI systems that power Arc XP. The team owns the Arc Intelligence API, a multi-tenant LLM and vector platform used across Arc products; Ask the News, which provides retrieval-augmented answers over a publisher's own archive; and the intelligence layer behind our personalization and audience products.

These are production systems serving publishers across North America, Europe, Latin America, and APAC. They support a wide range of newsroom, audience, and business workflows, and that breadth shapes how we build: with strong tenant isolation, reliable retrieval, thoughtful controls, and careful attention to cost, performance, and trust at scale.

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to lead technical direction across these systems. This is a senior individual contributor role with organizational technical leadership scope. You will define how these systems fit together, write the designs others build against, ship the hardest parts, and ensure the work scales across tenants, content models, languages, and operating requirements.

What Motivates You

• You're motivated by powering journalism that millions of readers around the world rely on.
• You develop clear, evidence-informed perspectives on quality and outcomes, and explain the reasoning behind them constructively.
• You believe a feature isn't finished when it works, but when it is instrumented, observable, and documented well enough for someone else to pick up.
• You don't wait for direction. You bring ideas forward, flag issues that deserve attention, and give leadership the input they need to make good decisions.
• You have a bias for elegance, choosing simplification and consolidation over adding more layers of configuration and logic.
• You thrive in fast-moving environments with many moving parts, shifting focus between priorities as the day unfolds.

How You'll Support The Mission

Platform Architecture

• Own the end-to-end design of Arc's AI platform: model routing, prompt management, vector storage, and agentic runtimes.
• Lead major architectural changes end to end, including solution design, security review, incremental rollout, and deprecation of what it replaced.
• Set technical direction that holds across the organization, keeping decisions coherent with the services we depend on.

AI Quality and Evaluation

• Own and evolve the evaluation infrastructure, keeping shared metrics reliable, relevant, and aligned with evolving quality needs.
• Lead the safe adoption of new models through staged rollout practices, quality checks, and clear recovery paths.
• Define and maintain AI guardrails that protect users, tenants, and platform reliability while keeping model capabilities aligned with product needs.

Multi-Tenancy, Security, and Privacy

• Own the multi-tenancy model and enforce tenant isolation in all new development.
• Partner with Security to strengthen privacy-by-default practices, with clear standards for data retention, minimization, erasure, and compliance controls.
• Partner with Security on threat modeling, secure design reviews, and prioritizing vulnerability remediation.

Production Ownership and Delivery

• Own the release train from customer test environments to production across regions, hotfixes included, without needing someone else to decide when it is safe to ship.
• Participate in the on-call rotation.
• Define and track key metrics for system health, customer activity, and business-critical workflows.
• Partner with operations and customer enablement to streamline customer setup and onboarding.

Technical Leadership and Product Ownership

• Drive what gets built. Bring ideas forward, shape the roadmap for your product area, and advocate for priorities with product and engineering leadership.
• Lead mob programming sessions, design reviews, and architecture discussions, using them to raise engineering standards rather than simply approving changes.
• Mentor and unblock other engineers through hands-on collaboration and design partnership.

Minimum Qualifications

The Skills and Experience You Bring

• 8+ years designing, building, and operating backend distributed systems at scale, including significant experience setting technical direction at the senior, staff, or principal level.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and architect across teams, influence technical direction without formal authority, and stay accountable for outcomes that depend on other teams' work.
• Strong Python experience, including production API development with FastAPI or a close equivalent.
• Deep AWS experience across core services, including Lambda, ECS, S3, CloudFront, DynamoDB, Bedrock, CodePipeline, and CodeBuild.
• Experience with infrastructure as code frameworks, including Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, or similar.
• Hands-on experience building production AI systems: model routing, retrieval architecture, embedding and chunking strategy, reranking, streaming responses, guardrails, and evaluation harnesses.
• Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture, including tenant isolation enforcement, per-tenant configuration, and usage metering.
• Demonstrated written clarity across design documents, roadmaps, and runbooks — much of this role's leverage is text.

We weigh practical equivalent experience equally and do not require a formal degree.

Preferred Qualifications

• Production-scale experience with vector embeddings, storage, and retrieval.
• Familiarity with workflow orchestration frameworks, such as Temporal.
• Familiarity with event streaming platforms, such as Kafka.
• Experience with NoSQL and document databases, such as MongoDB Atlas.
• Experience implementing observability with Datadog or comparable tooling, including APM, LLM observability, and application security monitoring.
• Experience evaluating and integrating multiple model providers and hosting options.
• Strong API and developer-experience craft: OpenAPI discipline, versioning, deprecation paths, backward compatibility, and predictable usage contracts.
• Comfortable leveraging AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude Code, across prototyping, implementation, testing, and documentation while applying strong engineering judgment.
• Experience evolving large-scale production systems while maintaining customer continuity across multiple languages or regions.
• Media, publishing, or newsroom technology background.
• Experience developing streaming media or rich content delivery workflows.
• Hands-on experience with multimodal AI tools for media analysis and generation, including video, photo, or audio.

Compensation And Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

• Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage
• Company-paid pension and 401(k) match
• Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave
• Nine paid holidays and two personal days
• 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent
• Robust mental health resources
• Backup care and caregiver concierge services
• Gender affirming services
• Pet insurance
• Free Post digital subscription
• Leadership and career development program

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status

The salary range for this position is:

$144,600 - $241,100 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

The Post strives to provide its readers with high-quality, trustworthy news and information while constantly innovating. That mission is best served by a diverse, multi-generational workforce with varied life experiences and perspectives. All cultures and backgrounds are welcomed.

We’re hiring a Backend Software Engineer to support a high‑visibility, data‑driven application used across the organization for analytics and reporting. About the Role. G2 Ops supports mission-critical defense and technology initiatives by solving complex operational and engineering challenges. We are seeking a motivated, collaborative Software Engineer / MBSE Plug-in Development, Mid to support Java-based modeling tool capabilities, SysML model generation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.

In this role, you’ll contribute to software engineering, model-based systems engineering, and digital engineering capabilities while working alongside a team that values innovation, technical excellence, and continuous growth.

What You'll Do

Software Development (70%)
• Develop and maintain JAVA-based software components and software application extensions
• Implement software capabilities for automated data processing, visualization, and workflow generation including, but not limited to: system architecture, component relationships, and process workflows
• Build and maintain parsers and data models for structured JSON inputs that drive model generation
• Use and extend internal utility libraries wrapping modeling APIs for semantic and presentation element creation
• Collaborate with AI engineering teams to align plugin behavior with LLM output expectations and improve robustness of AI-assisted generation workflows

Collaboration & Quality (30%)
• Diagnose and resolve issues across UI, parsing, API integration, and backend generation logic
• Contribute to code quality improvements, validation logic, and testing strategy across multi-repository codebase
• Support iterative feature delivery and coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure plugin capabilities align with modeling workflows

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field
• 3+ years of professional Java development experience
• Experience designing and maintaining object-oriented systems in production codebases
• Strong proficiency with JSON parsing/serialization and schema-driven data models
• Ability to debug complex workflows across UI, parsing, API integration, and backend logic
• Experience integrating software with REST or HTTP-based APIs
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical teams
• Ability to obtain and maintain required security clearance

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience building plugins for Cameo Systems Modeler, MagicDraw, or similar modeling tools
• Familiarity with SysML, MBSE, and model-based engineering concepts
• Experience with modeling tool APIs, sessions/transactions, and diagram automation
• Experience with Eclipse-based plugin environments or JavaFX/Swing UI development
• Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into engineering workflows
• Familiarity with prompt/schema design for structured LLM output

Why This Role Matters

Your code will directly enable systems engineers to rapidly develop high-quality models for defense systems that protect national security. You'll work on technically challenging problems at the intersection of software engineering, AI integration, and model-based systems engineering.

Ideal Candidate: A pragmatic Java engineer comfortable working in a specialized engineering domain who understands how structured data maps into model elements and diagrams, can debug issues across repository boundaries, and delivers features iteratively while maintaining technical rigor.
